description:

We are seeking an experienced data solutions professional to join our team as a Cloud Data Solutions Expert. This role involves designing, implementing and maintaining large-scale cloud-based data architecture solutions on Microsoft Azure.

  • Develop end-to-end cloud-based data architecture solutions using Microsoft Azure services.
  • Design and manage ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory.
  • Architect and optimize cloud storage solutions for structured and unstructured data.
  • Leverage big data processing, analytics, and machine learning workflows with Azure Databricks.

title: Sr Backend Developer - Java/Kotlin
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

· Avaliar, discutir e contribuir com a definição da arquitetura de sistemas.

· Traduzir requisitos de negócio em arquiteturas e sistemas.

· Analisar, documentar, codificar, revisar código, depurar, testar e entregar aplicações.

· Cuidar da monitoração do ambiente e criar ações proativas que garantam a saúde da plataforma.

· Interagir com equipes e áreas correlatas.

· Contribuir com melhorias de processos da engenharia.


Requisitos e qualificações:

· Superior em Tecnologia da Informação (ou áreas correlatas) ou experiência relevante.

· Conhecimento em estrutura de dados e paradigma de programação orientada a objetos.

· Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e microserviços.

· Experiência com linguagem de programação Java e/ou Kotlin.

· Experiência com framework Spring (Boot, Data, Cloud, etc).

· Experiência com Git, Gradle/Maven e ferramentas de CI/CD.

· Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais como Oracle e/ou MySQL.

· Experiência com desenvolvimento de API REST.

· Experiência com comunicação assíncrona utilizando brokers (RabbitMQ, JMS, Kafka, etc)

· Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de monitoração de sistemas como New Relic, Grafana, ELK, etc.

· Experiência com automação de testes.

· Conhecimento em padrões de desenvolvimento como SOLID, 12 factor e Domain Driven Design.

· Experiência com metodologias ágeis.

· Experiência com docker e plataforma kubernetes.

· Experiência com bancos NoSQL como MongoDB e DynamoDB.

· Experiência com Node.js e/ou Python.

· Experiência com AWS e terraform.


Informações adicionais:

A experiência de trabalhar na Invillia é única. E global. Temos o nosso próprio jeito de conectar talentos e construir inovações.

Revolucionamos o ambiente de trabalho #Instation + somos experts em desenvolver soluções complexas para #GameChangers + temos uma metodologia única #EngagedbyDataPeopleAction + investimos em pessoas #InvilliaAcademy

Alguns diferenciais Invillia:

_inovamos lado-a-lado com #GameChangersGlobais

_cultura de trabalho distribuído #inStation

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role

title: Tech Lead Machine Learning/Data Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Work with a high skilled team to leverage complex and high quality machine learning and statistical models;
  • Implement model to service integration via DAG creations and ETL processes;
  • Evaluate model performance under real data testing results and remodelate accordingly;
  • Build scalable models and DAGs to enable new workflows creations in a high-usage, high-demand environment;
  • Work with worldwide multidisciplinary distributed team, participate in technical discussions and definitions using English as main communication language;
  • Leverage accurate model architecture and documentation.



Essential Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Physics or related areas;
  • Desire to combine theory and abilities to solve problems pragmatically, applying Machine Learning techniques and integrating them into larger systems;
  • Desire to work with product managers and software engineers, translating requirements into design and models into end-to-end production code;
  • Knowledge in probability and statistical modeling;
  • Hands-on experience in statistical analysis and Machine Learning modeling using Python;
  • Hands-on experience on model evaluation, integration, data transformation and deployment, covering the complete end-to-end cycle;
  • Knowledge in SQL and relational databases;
  • Knowledge with DAG definition and implementation.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Python notebooks, pandas;
  • Experience with PySpark, Airflow;
  • Experience with cloud tools (AWS, Azure, GCP) and orchestration tools;
  • Knowledge about model life cycle, data drift and model drift;
  • Experience with data structures;
  • Experience with finops data treatment and cost saving analysis.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

  • Conhecimento em integrações com sistemas governamentais (Siscomex, RFB)

title: Mobile III (PLENO)
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Power Plataform SR
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar e desenvolver soluções low-code na Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint e Power BI), do desenho à entrega.
  • Integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (Dataverse, SQL Server, SharePoint, APIs), garantindo boa modelagem e performance.
  • Conduzir a equipe (mentoria, code review, distribuição de tarefas) e apoiar a gestão do backlog.
  • Definir arquitetura, padrões, ALM, segurança e governança da plataforma.
  • Construir relatórios/dashboards no Power BI e automatizar processos com Power Automate.
  • Documentar soluções, realizar testes e dar suporte na implantação e adoção.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prévia em projetos com Power Apps, Power Automate e SharePoint.
  • Vivência abrangente em Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, SharePoint e Power Automate).
  • Experiência em liderança de equipe e excelente comunicação/trabalho em equipe.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções low-code integradas a diferentes data sources.
  • Conhecimento desejável em SQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Perfil proativo, orientado a resultados e melhoria contínua.

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Scrum Master
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Scrum master who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

SAFe; Scrum; Kanban; jira; Agile

Familiarity with Scrum and Agile methodologies;

Basic knowledge of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) is an advantage;

Understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts and experience with applications hosted in cloud environments is preferred;

Eager to learn and grow in project management and cloud technology areas;

Advanced proficiency in English

Certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) is a plus but not required.

Should have worked at least 2-3 years as a Scrum Master;

Very good in Communication(English);

Experience in Project Management will be added advantage;

Should able to manage multiple Scrum Calls and Teams together;

Good understanding Consumer retail Business;

Well versed with Jira.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".

  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Analista de Dados Jr.
description:
O Analista de BI Júnior, com foco em analise e visualização de dados, responsável pela criação de índices estatísticos, pela gestão e limpeza de bases de dados e pela prestação de apoio de retaguarda, tanto a nível do desenvolvimento como da manutenção. Além disso, ele/ela implementa sistemas de automação e alertas que melhoram a eficiência, reduzem os tempos de auditoria e garantem a integridade e disponibilidade dos dados. Ele/ela também tem conhecimento de plataformas como Excel, Looker e Power Bi para relatórios e relatórios.


Principais Atribuições:


  • Capacidade de gerar insights e apoiar a tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Proficiência em Power BI, Looker e Excel (é necessário pelo menos um avançado);
  • Visualização de dados: Capacidade de criar visualizações claras e eficazes, facilitando a interpretação dos dados por equipas não técnicas;
  • Conhecimento em Google Analytics;
  • Comunicação eficaz: Capacidade de apresentar análises e resultados a diferentes públicos, tanto técnicos como não técnicos;
  • Colaboração interdisciplinar: Experiência de trabalho com equipas multifuncionais para alinhar a análise de dados com as necessidades estratégicas;
  • Capacidade para avaliar e contextualizar dados: Capacidade para interpretar a informação no contexto;
  • Capacidade para identificar padrões e tendências: Capacidade para detectar alterações ou movimentos significativos nos dados que possam influenciar a estratégia;
  • Abordagem analítica com sentido prático: capacidade de propor soluções eficazes baseadas em dados, tendo em conta as implicações e as necessidades.


Requisitos


  • Python e SQL para desenvolvimentos e processamento de dados;
  • Experiência com Google Analytics e Big Query;
  • Conhecimentos de estatística e matemática (desejável):
  • Conhecimento de estatística.

title: Engenheiro (a) de IA Sênior
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina, com metodologia própria e equipes técnicas altamente especializadas em automação, Hyperautomation, IA e Engenharia de Dados.


Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft, Diamond Partner da UiPath e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa sólida atuação em serviços de automação e inteligência artificial nos rendeu reconhecimentos relevantes, como o selo USN (UiPath Services Network) e o prêmio LATAM Partner of the Year.


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior (SRE, Arquitetura e Engenharia de Dados). Este profissional será responsável por desenhar, desenvolver, operar e evoluir soluções de IA em ambientes de alta criticidade, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade, segurança e eficiência operacional.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Arquitetura de Soluções de IA
  • Engenharia de IA e MLOps
  • SRE aplicado a IA
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)
  • CI/CD e Automação
  • Observabilidade e Operação
  • Integração de Sistemas
  • Colaboração Técnica


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de IA/SER
  • LLMs e GenAI
  • Cloud pública (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Terraform ou CloudFormation
  • Docker e Kubernetes
  • CI/CD e automação
  • APIs REST
  • Python


Conhecimentos Adicionais (Diferenciais)


  • Engenharia de Dados
  • MLOps / LLMOps
  • Observabilidade
  • FinOps


Perfil Desejado


  • Visão sistêmica
  • Autonomia técnica
  • Organização
  • Mentalidade de escala
  • Comunicação clara

title: Salesforce Developer (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 3 years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Knowledge of Apex (triggers, classes, async) and best practices
  • Experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, Named Credentials)
  • Knowledge of SOQL and data volume handling
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD
  • Knowledge of Salesforce security (profiles, permission sets, sharing)
  • English level B2 and native Portuguese
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal (Porto or Lisbon) ; eligible for a Portuguese work visa, or holding EU/dual nationality


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.



Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: Temporary


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

description:
Desafio da Área e da Posição:



✅Realizar os estudos e orçamentos dos investimentos, através do desenvolvimento, entendimento e análise crítica dos entregáveis

✅Realizar avaliações de viabilidade econômico-financeiras de soluções e projetos, através do desenvolvimento, entendimento e análise crítica dos entregáveis

✅Elaborar o planejamento plurianual das concessionárias (quinquenal) além do levantamento das necessidades de investimentos (contratuais e não contratuais) e da elaboração/ atualização de orçamento das obras não contratadas.

✅Analisar os impactos financeiros gerados pelas mudanças de projeto, serviços não previstos e reivindicação de despesas dos empreendimentos, através da análise técnica na verificação dos quantitativos, preços novos e aderência ao contrato

✅Desenvolver junto às Unidades de Negócio/ Divisões as negociações relativas a engenharia de custos junto ao Poder Concedente, através do entendimento e análise crítica dos orçamentos dos investimentos extra contratuais ou oportunidades dos investimentos contratuais e elaboração das respostas e justificativas técnicas, quando necessário, ou com a participação em reuniões técnicas com as Agências

✅Atuar de forma integrada com as demais áreas da concessionaria , visando a integração de competências, em busca das alternativas de projetos que geram valor ao negócio, desenvolvendo a estruturação das engenharias de valores através da análise crítica das lições registradas além de contribuir com a identificação e registro

✅Atuar de forma integrada com Suprimentos, acompanhando os resultados das solicitações com o objetivo de trazer aos projetos em estudo a solução mais econômica



Requisitos e qualificações


O que esperamos de você:

✅ Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Civil/produção;

✅ Experiência em orçamento de obras;

✅ Domínio nas ferramentas do Pacote Office (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook);

✅Conhecimento em tabelas públicas como SICRO, SINAPI, TPU DER/SP


Você se destaca, se tiver:


✅ Especialização / Pós-Graduação em Gestão de Projetos ou Engenharia de Custos;

✅ Habilitação CNH “B” – Disponibilidade para viagens;

✅ Conhecimento em Power Bi;

✅ Conhecimento em Compor90;

title: Product implementer / DTP freelancer
description:
Do you have a creative mindset backed by technical skills, experience in DTP, or a strong desire to learn?

BubblyDoo is looking for a hands-on freelance Product Implementer to join our team on a flexible basis, starting in Q1 2026. You will kick off with Valentine’s, Mother’s Day, and Father’s Day books for our in-house products, but also for various licensing partners (such as Peppa Pig from Hasbro, PAW Patrol from Paramount, Barbie from Mattel, and more!). You’ll support the launch of new personalized children’s books and products, working closely with our in-house team and software developer.

What you’ll do

  • Use various in-house tools like our Translation Tool and Product Builder to fully implement our books and the translations of our books and products
  • Prepare and configure our CMS for each new launch
  • Have direct contact with our translators, illustrators and editors for quality review and product improvements
  • Support with organizing Photoshop files to ensure all visual assets are ready for production

What we’re looking for

  • Flexible availability starting in January 2026, with an initial onboarding and training phase, followed by a predominantly full-time availability through at least June. Workload may vary at times, and timing and continuation will be evaluated together afterwards.
  • Strong communication skills
  • Comfortable using internal tools and learning quickly
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and structured

What’s in it for you

  • Join a small, young, and passionate team that cares deeply about what we create
  • Take ownership and responsibility for the quality of our product line
  • Compensation to be agreed upon

For questions or more information about the role, don’t hesitate to reach out to

Looking forward to connect and to a great collaboration!

title: Médico de saúde ocupacional
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Médico(a) do Trabalho para atuar de forma estratégica e assistencial, com foco na promoção da saúde, prevenção de doenças e gestão de programas ocupacionais, em conformidade com a legislação vigente e políticas internas.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar exames médicos ocupacionais (admissional, periódico, retorno ao trabalho, mudança de função e demissional), conforme NR-7 e protocolos internos;
  • Avaliar e acompanhar afastamentos previdenciários e não previdenciários, apoiando a gestão de absenteísmo;
  • Notificar e registrar acidentes de trabalho e doenças ocupacionais, conforme legislação;
  • Prestar atendimentos de urgência e emergência, seguindo protocolos institucionais;
  • Coordenar e executar o PCMSO e apoiar ações do PCA;
  • Desenvolver e participar de campanhas de saúde, ergonomia e qualidade de vida;
  • Analisar indicadores de saúde ocupacional, propondo medidas preventivas;
  • Atuar em parceria com equipes de SST, RH e demais áreas para construção de um ambiente seguro e saudável.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Medicina com CRM ativo;
  • Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho (título pela ANAMT será um diferencial);
  • Experiência em gestão de PCMSO, afastamentos e programas de prevenção;
  • Conhecimento sólido das Normas Regulamentadoras, especialmente NR-7, NR-9 e NR-17;
  • Vivência em empresas de médio ou grande porte, em ambientes industriais ou corporativos;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de saúde ocupacional (SOC, FAP online ou similares).


Local de Atuação: Campo Grande/MS

Horário: 20h semanais

Desenvolver e implementar modelos estatísticos e preditivos customizados;

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Dental Plan

description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP


Experiência Profissional


Inglês fluente ou avançado para escrita e conversação - Obrigatório


Requisitos


  • Excelente conhecimento em desenvolvimento ABAP no S/4, incluindo Steampunk e conceitos de SAP Clean Core
  • Conhecimento em criação de CDS Views , ODATA & REST e integração orientada por APIs .
  • Experiência em ABAP on S/4 HANA de 3 a 4 anos – CDS , AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures) e table functions , RAP Framework (RESTful Application Programming)
  • Habilidades de integração no S/4 usando Rest API e SProxy
  • Experiência com Adobe Forms
  • Conhecimento do processo SolMan Charm
  • Conhecimento em pesquisa de SAP Notes como parte do tratamento de defeitos. Registrar OSS-cases na SAP e instalar SAP Notes
  • Conhecimento em instalação e/ou ativação de versões de países do S/4
  • Conhecimento em instalação de namespaces para integração com sistemas legais
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado para escrita e conversação - Obrigatório
  • Conhecimento em tributação do Brasil
  • Conhecimento em tributação do Peru e do Chile será um diferencial
  • Espanhol será um diferencial


Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação completa.


Modelo de trabalho:


  • Remoto

title: Desenvolvedor Back End SR
description:
Desenvolvedor Back End - atuação internacional


Descrição:

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para Desenvolvedores experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


Atuação:

Como desenvolvedor de software você será responsável por projetar, codificar, testar e executar aplicativos de software construídos com arquitetura de microsserviços, que se comunicam por meio de APIs e são hospedados na AWS. Esses aplicativos possibilitam experiências digitais inovadoras e baseadas em dados que melhoram a eficácia operacional de um dos maiores players Globais no seguimento. Você trabalhará como parte de uma equipe ágil, com consultores de várias localidades do globo, empregando as melhores práticas em desenvolvimento, segurança e design.


Perfil técnico:

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência como engenheiro de software
  • B.Sc. em ciência da computação, engenharia elétrica ou equivalente
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência em Python
  • Experiência com Golang é uma vantagem
  • Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de frameworks de serviços distribuídos
  • Experiência prática com bancos de dados distribuídos, como RDS/Aurora/PostgreSQL, Redshift, DynamoDB, Redis, MongoDB, etc.
  • Experiência prática no uso de tecnologias de correio de mensagens, como SNS/SQS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, etc.
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com a AWS
  • Experiência com CDK é uma vantagem
  • Experiência com arquitetura de Microsserviços, Docker e Kubernetes
  • Experiência na construção de pipelines CI/CD usando Terraform (preferencial) ou Azure DevOps


Mandatório:

  • Bacharelado em Ciências da Computação ou similar;
  • Inglês fluente

  • Experiência com CDK é uma vantagem

  • Experiência na construção de pipelines CI/CD usando Terraform (preferencial) ou Azure DevOps

  • Inglês fluente

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Overview

A US-based financial services organization is seeking an experienced Snowflake Data Engineer to support the ongoing development and optimization of its cloud data platform. This role will focus on building and maintaining scalable ETL pipelines, enforcing strong data governance practices, and preparing the enterprise data warehouse to leverage advanced capabilities such as Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence.


This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to ensure high-quality, secure, and analytics-ready data.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines within Snowflake to support analytics and downstream use cases
  • Develop and maintain scalable data models to support reporting, BI, and advanced AI/ML workloads
  • Implement and enforce data governance best practices, including data quality, lineage, access controls, and compliance requirements
  • Prepare and structure data to enable future adoption of Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence capabilities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Monitor and improve performance, cost efficiency, and reliability of the Snowflake data warehouse
  • Support documentation and knowledge sharing across the data engineering function


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience as a Data Engineer working with Snowflake in production environments
  • Proven experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines at scale
  • Solid understanding of data governance, data quality frameworks, and security best practices
  • Experience working in regulated or financial services environments is strongly preferred
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with cloud-based data warehouses


Preferred / Advantageous Skills

  • Experience with modern data tools such as:
  • dbt

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Overview

A US-based financial services organization is seeking an experienced Snowflake Data Engineer to support the ongoing development and optimization of its cloud data platform. This role will focus on building and maintaining scalable ETL pipelines, enforcing strong data governance practices, and preparing the enterprise data warehouse to leverage advanced capabilities such as Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence.


This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to ensure high-quality, secure, and analytics-ready data.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines within Snowflake to support analytics and downstream use cases
  • Develop and maintain scalable data models to support reporting, BI, and advanced AI/ML workloads
  • Implement and enforce data governance best practices, including data quality, lineage, access controls, and compliance requirements
  • Prepare and structure data to enable future adoption of Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence capabilities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Monitor and improve performance, cost efficiency, and reliability of the Snowflake data warehouse
  • Support documentation and knowledge sharing across the data engineering function


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience as a Data Engineer working with Snowflake in production environments
  • Proven experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines at scale
  • Solid understanding of data governance, data quality frameworks, and security best practices
  • Experience working in regulated or financial services environments is strongly preferred
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with cloud-based data warehouses


Preferred / Advantageous Skills

  • Experience with modern data tools such as:
  • dbt
  • Fivetran
  • Matillion
  • Apache Airflow
  • Experience collaborating with data science or AI teams

title: US Immigration Paralegal (Employment Based Petitions)
description:
Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Type: Full-Time


Company Description

Beyond Border is a modern immigration platform founded by immigrants, for immigrants, dedicated to supporting U.S. mobility needs for technologists, artists, and skilled professionals. The company's mission is to simplify the immigration process, making it accessible and efficient for individuals and businesses alike. With innovative solutions and expertise, Beyond Border provides comprehensive support throughout the immigration journey to help clients achieve their goals. Learn more about their services at Beyond Border Global.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote position for a Immigration Paralegal specializing in U.S. Employment-Based Petitions. The responsibilities include assisting with the preparation and submission of employment-based visa petitions and other immigration filings, conducting research on immigration law and policies, reviewing and organizing legal documents, and collaborating with attorneys and clients to ensure compliance. The candidate will also provide ongoing support to clients, maintain case management systems, and monitor deadlines and case progress.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of US O1,EB1,EB2 petition experience with a successful track record of approvals is a must.
  • Strong knowledge of Law, Immigration Law, and Immigration Issues
  • Experience with Visas and Employment-Based Immigration Processes
  • Proficiency in Legal Document Preparation and detail-oriented case management
  • Exceptional organizational, time-management, and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines in a remote environment
  • Bachelor’s degree or paralegal certification; prior experience in immigration law is highly preferred

title: Gerente de Processos e Excelência Operacional
description:
A SWM International é uma multinacional produtora de papéis para indústria do tabaco e soluções em papéis especiais.


Somos fabricantes especializados de uma variedade de materiais avançados, presentes no dia a dia das pessoas. Nós fazemos parte do seu dia com nossos produtos de qualidade e colaboramos com nossos clientes para fornecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas para aumentar o valor de seus produtos.


Agora, queremos convidar você a fazer parte do nosso dia a dia, onde cada colaborador é essencial para o sucesso da nossa empresa.

Traga o seu talento para a SWM!


Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente de Processos e Excelência Operacional para atuar em uma posição permanente na nossa Unidade em Piraí, no Rio de Janeiro.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Gestão da rotina operacional:

Garantir a execução dos padrões operacionais

Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs)

Conduzir reuniões de performance e atuar sobre desvios

Direcionar atividades, desenvolver competências e acompanhar resultados

Estimular a cultura de melhoria contínua e excelência operacional

Validar ganhos e apoiar o orçamento com dados de produtividade

  • Formação acadêmica

Desejável pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos ou Gestão de Negócios

Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em ambiente industrial

Experiência com excelência operacional e melhoria contínua

Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC, Kaizen, 5S, FMEA, Ishikawa, CEP)

Gestão de Processos (BPMN, POPs, KPIs, análise de gargalos)

Normas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001)

Salário atrativo conforme mercado

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Pride Global is hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Brazil. Please apply for consideration!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ - Open Ended


Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our innovative team. You will develop high-quality, performant, and testable code contributing directly to company-wide initiatives using exciting technologies such as Elixir , Ruby, React , Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.

You’ll have a strong influence on technical decisions, collaborate closely with product and engineering teams, and continuously improve your skills and our systems.


Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality, performant, and testable code aligned with company initiatives
  • Develop using technologies like Elixir, Ruby, React , Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka , AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB
  • Contribute to technical decision-making shaping the software’s future
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback
  • Collaborate with team members on feature development
  • Deploy user-facing code to production
  • Partner with product and engineering management to deliver solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Professional English fluency (written and spoken)
  • 3-5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience with reusable components and building component libraries
  • Understanding of production-ready web applications and systems
  • Passion for testing practices and continuous improvement
  • Experience with any of: Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, Next.js, or other programming languages
  • Familiarity with tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, and remote deployment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of event-based architectures, database fundamentals, and GraphQL
  • Enthusiasm for problem-solving and curiosity about retail/e-commerce, high-end consignment market, and sustainable circular economy for luxury goods

title: Principal Backend Engineer (Typescript)
description:
Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Principal Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Typescript and strong experience designing and evolving backend architectures. You will be expected to work with a high level of autonomy, driving technical decisions, defining best practices, and leading complex projects from design to deployment. This is not a managerial position, but you will act as a technical reference for the team, mentoring others and setting high standards for code quality, scalability, and DevOps practices.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and evolution of backend architectures, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Define and implement engineering best practices and frameworks to uplift our quality and resiliency.
  • Take ownership of complex technical initiatives, from planning and estimation to delivery.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Guide and mentor other engineers, sharing knowledge and reviewing code to ensure technical excellence.
  • Champion CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and DevOps best practices.
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement in our systems and propose architectural changes.


Technology Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a backend developer.
  • Deep expertise in Typescript and NestJS, with solid knowledge of relational and non‑relational databases.
  • Hands‑on experience designing and deploying microservices and event‑driven systems.
  • 3+ years running workloads on AWS Lambda and related services (DynamoDB, RDS), with strong understanding of cloud architecture patterns.
  • Strong understanding of clean code principles, separation of concerns, and software design patterns.
  • Solid experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code and monitoring practices is a plus.
  • Experience with Python is a plus.


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to work independently and drive projects with minimal supervision.
  • Strong project management mindset and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating and helping others grow.
  • Experience in frontend development is a plus.

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.

title: SWE Manager - Mobile
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: TECH LEAD .NET CORE
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de sistemas .NET Core, integrando práticas avançadas de IA Generativa ao fluxo de trabalho.

Atuação em Arquitetura: Papel colaborativo na definição de arquitetura (execução pelo time do cliente) e forte atuação na estipulação de diretrizes e boas práticas de código.

Competências Desejáveis:

Experiência no uso e disseminação de metodologias (AI Champion) e ferramentas baseadas em IA, como Cursor, Devin e GitHub Copilot, com o objetivo de otimizar o SDLC (automação, testes, refatoração) e aplicar prompt engineering

Experiência em desenvolvimento e arquiteturas de microsserviços baseados em eventos

Liderança e Gestão: mentoria técnica da equipe, resolução de desafios complexos, garantia da qualidade via code reviews e gestão de prazos de entrega.

Experiência e habilidade na tradução de requisitos de negócio para especificações técnicas e alinhamento de expectativas com o cliente.

Requisitos Técnicos: .NET 6/7/8+, Microsserviços, DDD, Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) e Bancos de Dados SQL/NoSQL.

Experiência em liderança ágil, mínimo de 3-5 anos, com boa capacidade de negociação/comunicação interna e com o cliente.


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Desejavel conhecimentos: Microsoft Azure, .NET Core, Angular, SQL Server, API REST, Containers Kuvernetes, CI/CD GitLab e GitOps, Message Queuing : Red Hat AMQ para mensageria.


Certificações

  • Desejavel certificações AZ



E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!
